prompt.description: (Optional) Text prompt words, used to guide the generation of animation content. Can be empty or 0 - 2500 characters long.

input_urls.description: (Required) Include a URL of an image

mode.description: (Optional) Video Quality Mode. std: Standard Mode (720p). pro: Professional Mode (1080p)

character_orientation.description: (Optional) Reference source for character orientation. video: Refer to video (recommended); image: Refer to image. Default value: video

background_source.description: (Optional) Background source. input_video: Use video background; input_image: Use image background. Default value: input_video
